name: v0.39.0
body:
## What's Changed
* docs: refresh README demo for NetWatch 0.38.0 by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/130
* fix(dense): fill process and connection sparklines across their width by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/131
* fix(whois): contact RDAP only when the user presses W by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/125
* fix: review follow-ups for Packets keys, detail graphs and window labels by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/132
* refactor(unsafe): use safe APIs and validate platform buffer boundaries by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/124
* fix(sandbox): close root and ProcBroker capability leaks by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/121
* fix(tui): restore terminal on panic and shutdown signals by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/126
* fix(security): redact remote URLs and bound hostile file reads by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/123
* fix(capture): preserve totals across counter wrap and bound tracking maps by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/122
* test(diagnose): run the loaded-sample test on a clock it controls by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/133
* fix(geo): bound the GeoIP and WHOIS caches and look up global addresses only by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/134
* fix(capture): byte-budget the packet ring and charge streams at true cost by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/135
* fix(incident): byte and row budgets for the flight recorder by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/136
* test: synthetic connection tables and timed scale tests (2k/10k/50k) by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/137
* test(tty): allocate one pty at a time so FreeBSD tests read their own by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/139
* test(soak): flood_soak driver, AF_PACKET flood generator and netns harness by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/141
* docs(security): publish threat model and verify policy inventories by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/127
* feat(sandbox): deny TCP and Unix sockets on parser threads by role by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/138
* fix(sandbox): drop CAP_NET_RAW where capture never reopens, drop CAP_NET_ADMIN, audit every thread by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/144
* perf: 10k-row collector poll, closed-history timeline, snapshot generation by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/142
* feat(metrics): capture received/dropped/decoded counters by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/143
* fix(ui): measure and cut text by the cells ratatui draws by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/140
* fix(diagnose): reject an overflowing --budget instead of panicking by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/145
* fix(remote): let retry backoff grow to its cap by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/149
* fix(config): refuse a config.toml that does not load instead of using defaults by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/146
* docs(unsafe): state the invariant at every unsafe site by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/148
* fix(capture): bound packet decoding by header lengths and fragment offset by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/147
* ci: run the flood soak weekly, by hand and as a pull request smoke by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/150
* feat(sandbox): seccomp no-socket filter, Landlock reporting in doctor, capability lab by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/151
* feat(geoip): add netwatch geoip update and remove the online lookup by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/152
* feat(privacy): third_party_probes switch, Insights cleartext warning, setcap recipe by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/153
* perf: build the Connections view once per snapshot, and find IPv6 socket verdicts by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/154
* hardening(unsafe): enforce SAFETY comments and unsafe extern with lints on every OS by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/155
* ci: load GeoIP in a full soak, and run geoip update live on every OS by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/156
* docs: publish the 0.39 performance numbers and the review plan's outcome by @matthart1983 in https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/pull/157


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/matthart1983/netwatch/compare/v0.38.0...v0.39.0
